_comentario: English texts of the port (the fallback language; docs/i18n.md). Flat object 'key': 'text'; {name} is a parameter, {{ and }} are literal braces; keys starting with '_' are comments. Keys: launcher.* (startup options screen), cli.* (command line), jogo.* (in-game texts generated by the port), mods.* (messages about mods and their scripts), lua.* (errors of the Lua API, read by mod authors in the log), mod.<mod name>.* (texts of a mod, brought by the mod itself). The texts of the original SimAnt are not here: they come from the user's installation.

cli.ajuda:
SimAnt recomp {versao} - a modern port of SimAnt (Maxis, 1991) that reads your own copy of the game.

Usage:
  simant                      without options: opens the launcher (startup options), or goes
                              straight to the game if the launcher settings ask for it
  simant [options]

Game and data:
  --jogo DIR                  folder of the original SimAnt for Windows (with SHARED.NDX)
  --dados DIR                 port data folder (default: data next to the program)
  --mods DIR                  mods folder (default: mods)
  --desligar-mods A,B         mods that are not loaded (names from mod.json)
  --idioma CODE               language of the port's texts (data/idiomas/idiomas.json; default:
                              the system language if available, otherwise English)

Start:
  --novo-jogo [--tipo T]      new game: rapido (Quick), completo (Full), experimental or tutorial
  --semente N                 seed of the new game
  --save FILE.ANT             load a saved game

Window:
  --resolucao WxH             virtual screen: 640x480, 800x600 or 1024x768
  --escala N                  integer scale (0 = the largest that fits)
  --janela WxH                initial window size
  --moldura | --sem-moldura   Windows 3.1 title bar and frame on or off
  --moldura-do-sistema | --sem-moldura-do-sistema
                              with --moldura: keep the system border or replace it (default)
  --perfil-driver P           imitated video driver: vga, svga256 or s3_dosbox

Pace (data/partida.json):
  --velocidades proporcional|original   Fast/Ultra pace
  --sem-foco lenta|original             pace while the window is not focused

Sound:
  --sem-som | --com-som       sound off or on
  --sintetizador simples|soundfont|fm
  --soundfont FILE.sf2        General MIDI SoundFont for the soundfont synthesizer
  --exportar-som DIR [--exportar-musica ID]   export effects and music as WAV and quit

Player preferences:
  --preferencias FILE         preferences file (default: in the user data folder)
  --sem-preferencias          do not read or write preferences
  --win-ini FILE              WIN.INI read while there are no preferences yet

Launcher and output:
  --launcher                  open the launcher even with other options
  --config FILE | --sem-config   launcher settings file, or none
  --console                   open a console for the program output (Windows)
  --capturar-launcher FILE.png   draw the launcher into a PNG and quit
  --help, -h                  show this help

Automation (tests and comparisons, without a window): --ticks N, --avancar-ms MS,
  --exportar-tela-jogo FILE.png, --exportar-telas DIR, --salvar FILE.ANT, --acoes A,B,
  --botoes F,F, --historico B,B, --fechar-avisos N, --sair-apos-ms N, --capturar-janela FILE.png,
  --menu, --dialogo, --quintal, --janela-mapa, --mini-mapa, --examinar, --marcar, --trilhas.

Documentation: README.md and docs/ (docs/i18n.md for languages, docs/api-mods.md for mods).
